reviews.t: The Best Cover Up Out There for Face and Body
reviews.x: As someone who compulsively and chronically picks at her skin, this product is a match made in heaven. Not only is it great coverage, but it has ingredients in it to speed up healing. I love that I'm putting makeup on my face that's improving my skin. Acne marks and marks left behind by bug bites, and so much more are easily covered up, It's a little pricey, but a little goes such a long way, and the mini version lasted me several months previously. reviews.t: Excellent concealer; just beware that when they say 'light', they mean LIGHT!
reviews.x: I had a small bruise on my face from a cosmetic procedure, and it was driving me crazy that none of my concealers or foundations would cover it. Several friends had gotten the Boo-Boo concealer in a beauty box, and highly recommended it, so I grabbed it when I saw Amazon had it on sale.  I'm very fair, so I got the light version. Ummm, I guess I'm not as fair as I thought; they aren't kidding when they say 'fair'! This is Caspar white!  No matter. I mixed a bit of foundation in a more human shad

This is my all time favorite face makeup. I use it as a foundation with a tiny tiny bit going a long long way. It does not irritate my roseacia, nor does it look like I am even wearing makeup. Lasts forever, doesn't rub off on everything, doesn't feel "wet" on my face. perfect color. No irritating scent. Seriously, I should probably buy about 40 tubes of this so if they ever go out of business I have it for life. I first tried this in my Ipsy subscription, and it is the BEST thing to hap

I got this to reduce the visibility of a skin cancer removal scar on my leg.  It's super concentrated, I mean REALLY concentrated.  It takes some practice to get used to applying the correct small amount.  For me, it doesn't make the scar invisible, but it reduces the discoloration enough so that I'm not self conscious about it.  It's pretty much what I was looking for.

I absolutely love this concealer.  I first received it in an Ipsy bag, and I am now hooked.  It covers great and lasts all day.  I typically use it for under my eyes but have used it to cover a few blemishes as well.  My favorite go to concealer now!

I’m not sure what is on this but it works like voodoo magic… especially on fresh, open spots. It helps to roll your finger back and forth over the spot instead of dabbing or spreading. Let it sit for about 5 minutes and it will stay put under foundation. Be sure to carefully / gently dab over to blend with makeup. Since there isn’t a color choice, I was pleasantly surprised how close it was to my concealer. I have fair to medium skin that burns before tanning. A little goes a VERY long way. I’m

reviews.t: THE BEST COVER UP HANDS DOWN!!!!
reviews.x: This is hands down the BEST COVER UP I HAVE EVER USED IN MY ENTIRE LIFE!!! I am almost half a century old, oooohhhhh that hurt to say. I only mention my age to give a greater impact to my statement about this product. Over the years I have tried everything! I have had acne most of my life, still do. I have ruddy skin, freckles, acne scars, and age spots from my days worshiping the sun and tanning bed. So, when I say this stuff is amazing I really mean it!

reviews.t: No different than any cheaper, average makeup. Nothing remarkable.
reviews.x: I don’t think this covers “boo-boos” any better than just your average makeup that’s a fraction of the price. I have a lot of scaring and I’m a picker so I’m very self conscious about the marks my bad habits have left. To the point I avoid shorts or tanks if at all possible. So my hopes were high with this but sadly it fell short. It’s noticible on skin even when blended. No hiding you’ve put makeup on your body.

Love this product, I received an earlier tube from a promotional box and WOW, the stuff covers well and stays put!  (I use it for undereye coverage not boo boos, although some mornings my eyes look like it)  I will keep this in my cosmetic box forever!  The light is really light, if you're very light skinned it's the perfect color or if you're doing contouring it's perfect.

reviews.t: Great for cystic acne and sensitive skin
reviews.x: Great coverage. I have found the concealer I consistently go back to time and time again. My face decided, (at 30, mind you!) that acne was a good look for me. This is the only thing that not only covers the spots, but helps heal the cystic spots that break open. AND it doesn't irritate them! I love this stuff!

reviews.t: I got this in my Ipsy bag in May I ...
reviews.x: I got this in my Ipsy bag in May I believe. I have used it almost every day since I first received it and I am still not out of it! This stuff works wonders! When I am close to the end I will, without a doubt, be buying more.

reviews.t: I love it. It feels velvety smooth and doesn't settle ...
reviews.x: I got a sample of boo boo cover up from Ipsy. I love it. It feels velvety smooth and doesn't settle in wrinkles.  So far the best cover up , I have ever tried.

reviews.t: it is pretty good. But there is a better but more ...
reviews.x: For the price, it is pretty good. But there is a better but more expensive option, which is the Keromask Camouflage Cream.

I received this in my ipsy glam bag 4 days ago. I absolutely love it!! It hides my dark circles and any redness on my face and best of all it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. There are so few concealer a I can use because my skin has a reaction and the ones that don't irritate my skin don't cover up anything. This covers so well I decided to do an experiment and used it to cover a petal on one of my tattoos.....full coverage and it didn't look all thick and unnatural!!!! I'm impressed and wil

reviews.t: More natural coverage than industrial-strength, but I like it nonetheless
reviews.x: I really like this concealer. It doesn't give the most coverage I've ever used (that goes to Benefit Erase Paste, now called Boi-ing or something). But it's matte, but still somehow smooth, creamy and not-too-drying. I usually wear "light" with concealers, but I got the medium based on advice in the reviews, and that has worked out perfectly. Good stuff. Oh -- and yes, the other reviews that say this tube is TINY are true. Glad I bought it, though. I might get the larger tube later.

I swear by this concealer! I continue to buy it after receiving a sample in my Ipsy bag. It beats any concealer I've ever used, and for a fraction of the cost. It also helps heal breakouts, which is amazing. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: I love this product though and it cover really well
reviews.x: I bought this to blend with the light one I already have since my skin is a little darker in the summer. This product is much darker than I wxpected it to be. I love this product though and it cover really well!
Well magic in the little tube it really covers up a little dark spots on my hands and the circles under my eyes or I would say 90% better. Must buy!!!
I love this stuff. I got it in my Ipsy bag & fell in love immediately. This will cover many blemishes without looking cakey, Will be purchasing more.
Best concealer ever! This small tube last over 6 months because a little goes a long way!
Covers well, tho a little cakey.  Nice small size alternative for travel bag or purse.

Covers my scars from skin cancer removal on my nose.  I had 38 stitches and the scar looks like a goal post.  Tried  a couple of other brands.  Boo Boo really is best of the group by far!  I'm fair with freckles and the medium is a little light even on me, but I'm sure the dark would be too dark.  The tube is tiny--smaller than a regular lipstick, but I only need a drop.  Pea-size would cover my face and I could apply to be a kabuki dancer.  I can't imagine I'll go through the entire tube even.

The best concealer I have ever found, I've tried tons from ulta and sephora, this is the BEST!  It is not shimmery, and it covers everything so well!  The color is a perfect match!  I chose medium, I'm an olive skin tone and it's perfect for summer and winter. I have a few color match concealers that are supposed to change to match my skin color, this matches way better, even on my sister who usually needs a lighter color than me.  AND it really does help heal my boo boos!  BUY IT, you won't reg

I love my cat. She’s my fur baby, but once you pet her too much she gets a little feisty if you stop. As such, I am left with scratches all over my arms. I have been looking for the right product to cover evidence of my cat’s adoration and I’ve finally found it. This stuff is amazing, covers great and lasts for hours and hours. I use it with Dermablend Setting Powder and they’re a match made in heaven. It’s very light, but so am I so I’m happy as a clam. Just bought 2 more tubes so I won’t run o

I first discovered this product through "ipsy". As soon as I tried it, I was hooked. I use the "Medium" shade and it has provided amazing coverage when my face is pale in the winter and slightly tan in the summer. A little goes a long way, so one tube can last me about 5 or 6 months. I also have very temperamental skin, and this product has never irritated it. I would recommend this product to anyone who needs quality concealer that will last all day.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the coverage, calling it the best cover-up they have used and effective on acne, scars, blemishes, and dark circles.
Many reviewers note the product is highly concentrated, so only a tiny amount is needed and it lasts a long time.
Several reviewers say it does not irritate sensitive or rosacea-prone skin and some report it helps heal spots.
Some reviewers warn the 'light' shade is very light and that application takes practice to get the right amount.
A few reviewers find the coverage unremarkable for the price or less than expected compared to other concealers.
